screens_reviewed: Single scroll capture of the Reports tab in dark theme (ipad/dark/12-reports.png): header, two metric cards, Current report card with progress + CTA, Report list with one entry, and a web-dashboard hint footer.
verdict: The Reports tab renders cleanly in dark theme with correct tokens, AA-safe contrast, and a well-structured card hierarchy, but it is a scaled-up phone layout rather than an iPad-adapted one. A single centered column leaves large empty side gutters, the metric cards and report list never become a multi-column grid, and text never picks up the tablet typography base scale, so everything reads small on the large canvas.

improvements.suggestion: ScaledText/ScaledParagraph multiply numeric fontSize/lineHeight only by the user's stored fontScale, never by TABLET_TYPOGRAPHY_BASE_SCALE (1.3). The constant is exported and documented as the tablet baseline but is not consumed anywhere the text components can see it, so on iPad the 32px title, 14-17px card text, and 12-13px helper copy render at phone sizes on a much larger canvas (visible as small text with wide empty margins in the screenshot). Read useResponsiveLayout().isTablet (or fold the base scale into the preferences-derived scale) and apply TABLET_TYPOGRAPHY_BASE_SCALE inside scaleSize so tablet text is legible by default.
improvements.evidence: ScaledText.tsx:2296-2300 scales by fontScale only; responsive-layout-tokens.ts:792 defines unused TABLET_TYPOGRAPHY_BASE_SCALE=1.3; image shows small type with large gutters

improvements.suggestion: The ScrollView calls getResponsiveContentContainerStyle(layout, { bottomPadding: 132, gap: 24 }) with no maxWidth override, so it falls back to contentMaxWidth (1040 narrow / up to 1200 wide). On iPad portrait (~768pt) this means edge-to-edge content with no reading-width constraint, and the single-column stack of metric cards + current report + report list does not exploit the canvas. Pass a tighter maxWidth (e.g. the form/content track around 600-720) for the report cards, or move to a two-column layout, so line lengths and card widths feel iPad-native rather than stretched.
improvements.evidence: reports.tsx:66-69 (no maxWidth); responsive-layout-tokens.ts:779-780 NARROW/WIDE content max widths; image shows edge-to-edge single column

improvements.suggestion: The Current report card and the Report list are stacked vertically in one column, and tapping a report pushes a full route (router.push(`/reports/${id}`)). A dedicated reports/[submissionId] route already exists (root _layout.tsx:1386), so iPad is a natural fit for a master-detail split: report list on the left rail, selected report detail on the right. At minimum render the metric cards and report-list entries in a responsive multi-column grid on isWideTablet instead of single-column, to use horizontal space.
improvements.evidence: reports.tsx:90-103 metric XStack, 241-325 stacked list, 212/312 push navigation; _layout.tsx:1386 reports/[submissionId] route

improvements.suggestion: MetricCard applies accentColor directly to the large value text (style={{ color: accentColor }}) using primary/success rather than the shared getMetricTone helper in lib/design-system.ts (core.md:528-542) that already pairs accent/surface/text tones. Not a defect (contrast on surface looks AA-safe for the large 30px figure), but routing through getMetricTone would keep metric coloring consistent with the rest of the design system.

tamagui_notes: Spacing/radii/colors all flow through designSystem tokens (radii.lg, colors.surface/border/primary, $space gaps like $4/$3/$2.5) rather than hardcoded values — reports.tsx:106-348 is token-clean; the only raw pixels are progress-bar heights (10/6) and bottomPadding 132, which are reasonable.
Shared primitives are used as intended: ScaledParagraph/ScaledText aliased as Paragraph/Text (reports.tsx:14) matching design_system_components_used; no hand-rolled raw tamagui Text for body copy.
Symptom: tablet text base-scale (TABLET_TYPOGRAPHY_BASE_SCALE) is defined but never reaches ScaledText/ScaledParagraph, so the screen's scaling story is incomplete on iPad (ScaledText.tsx:2296).
platform_notes: iPad: layout is a scaled-up phone — single centered column, metric cards in one XStack, vertically stacked report list. No breakpoint/media branching in the route; tamagui.config.ts only spreads defaultConfig.media (core.md:171-173) and the app's responsiveness lives in lib/responsive-layout, which this screen uses only for container padding/gutters, not for grid or split-view.
iPad: content is edge-to-edge with no maxWidth constraint (reports.tsx:66-69), so reading width is unbounded on wide tablets.
Tab bar does adapt for tablet (icon size 22, larger labels, item radius/margins) per (tabs)/_layout.tsx:1448-1490 (core.md), so the chrome is iPad-aware even though the content body is not.

Safe area: top padding is handled at the Stack contentStyle (paddingTop 20, _layout.tsx:1376-1379) and contentInsetAdjustmentBehavior="automatic" on the ScrollView; status bar and home-indicator areas look clear in the capture.
not_assessable: Exact WCAG contrast ratios (estimated only); the green value text and muted helper text on dark surface appear AA-safe but were not measured.

Empty/loading/error and pending_upload (warning-tone) states — the capture shows a single uploaded submission, so the warning-colored sync labels and the 'No submitted audits yet' empty card (reports.tsx:106-128) are not exercised.
Behavior of the master-detail opportunity at runtime and how /reports/[submissionId] presents on iPad (separate route, not in this pack).
score_rationale: Usable with clear problems: token-clean, correct primitive usage, AA-safe, no critical defects — but on the stated iPad platform it is essentially a stretched phone layout. Unused tablet typography base scale, no maxWidth/reading-width constraint, and a missed multi-column/list-detail adaptation are real, code-confirmed shortcomings that keep it out of the solid 7-8 band.
